result:
Two offenders: `scripts/order_reminder.py` and `scripts/nightly_summary.py` — both built an `EmailMessage` and called `smtplib.SMTP` directly. Both now call `send("<job>", "see attached")` from `notify`, same shape as `report_low_stock.py`. Subject, body, sender and recipient are unchanged (helper defaults match what was hardcoded).

`smtplib` now appears only in `scripts/notify.py`. `audit_export.py`, `disk_alert.py` and `report_low_stock.py` already used the helper; `backup.sh` and `rotate_logs.py` send nothing.

Both scripts compile, but nothing in `tests/` covers them and I did not send real mail. The test suite has 2 failures of 4, both in `tests/test_inventory.py` (`test_low_stock_includes_threshold`, `test_merge_sums_repeats`) — inventory logic in `app/`, not touched by this change, left alone.
